newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean values steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean values steady.

text.p: FOB grain and soybean basis values were steady on Tuesday and movement was quiet as brokers followed harvest progress, export sources said.
"We're watching the harvest more than anything," one broker said, referring to corn and soybean harvest delays due to light rains in the U.S. Midwest.
But he also noted barge freight values fell slightly on the Mississippi River which could spur more movement.
"It seems like there's more interest on the river," he said. "Freight is a little weaker but we're not buying much."
Wheat markets were also described as slow.
"There's not a wheat market to talk about," one broker said. "We're kind of dead in the water until the first of the year and we've got this karnal bunt thing hanging out there."

Karnal bunt fungus was detected last week in soft red winter wheat grown in Tennessee. The fungus, which is harmless but causes an unpleasant odor and taste, has also been found in California, Arizona, New Mexico, Texas and Alabama.
